description: Source code for Playwright's custom expect matchers, including proxy-based matcher creation, polling support, and test step integration.

classes.name: ExpectMetaInfoProxyHandler
classes.description: Proxy handler for managing matcher property access, resolving qualified matcher names, and handling poll support.

methods.name: createMatchers
methods.description: Creates a proxy for matchers with attached meta information.

methods.name: qualifiedMatcherName
methods.description: Generates a qualified matcher name using a qualifier array and matcher name.

methods.name: createExpect
methods.description: Creates a proxy-based expect object with support for configuration, extension, and polling.

methods.name: setMatcherCallContext
methods.description: Sets the current matcher call context for tracking within a test step.

methods.name: takeMatcherCallContext
methods.description: Retrieves and clears the current matcher call context.

methods.name: wrapPlaywrightMatcherToPassNiceThis
methods.description: Wraps a matcher to pass Playwright-specific context and timeout handling.

methods.name: throwUnsupportedExpectMatcherError
methods.description: Throws an error for unsupported custom matchers.

methods.name: pollMatcher
methods.description: Performs polling for a matcher until timeout or success.
